Method of Attack: Use of stolen malware and hijacked infrastructure from OilRig to attack targets
Use of ASPX-based backdoor, Snake rootkit, Neuron and Nautilus implants to compromise, maintain persistence, and exfiltrate data
Scanning for presence of Iranian backdoors and exploiting them to gain foothold
Exfiltrating data including directory listings, files, and keylogger output
Dropping implants on systems already compromised with Snake rootkit
Discoverer: United Kingdom's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC)
Impacted Systems: Victims in at least 35 countries including Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, UAE
Middle Eastern companies and government agencies
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Iranian command and control (C2) servers
Virtual Private Server (VPS) IP addresses connected to OilRig
Keylogger output containing operational activity from Iranian actors
